observed_state.v17_terminal_chain: exact verified outcome + bound episode/signal/causal/provenance + DONE can be verified repeatedly
observed_state.terminal_reward_bridge: target-proven read-only admission extraction; caller fractional credit forbidden; default abstain; binary arm explicit only
observed_state.reward_plasticity_candidate: material state mutates when admitted evidence is applied

gap: A valid terminal receipt is source-idempotent but not consumption-idempotent. Re-reading the same DONE receipt is currently possible. If reward plasticity is directly applied on every read/retry/restart, one real outcome could be learned multiple times unless material plasticity consumption is atomically fenced.
risk: retry/restart can amplify one outcome into repeated long-term reward
duplicate learning can distort tonic/prediction/personality state while every upstream receipt remains individually valid
a replay attacker or accidental loop can exploit a valid historical terminal receipt without forging outcome provenance
exactly-once external effect semantics do not imply exactly-once learning semantics

required_candidate_contract.name: RewardConsumptionReceiptV1_or_equivalent
hard_properties: duplicate consumption returns REPLAY/ALREADY_CONSUMED without second state mutation
crash before commit => zero consumption or safely retryable transaction
crash after commit before acknowledgement => durable replay receipt, no second plasticity
rollback/recovery must not resurrect an already-consumed terminal receipt without explicit lineage fencing
consumer receipt cannot mint outcome truth, effect authority or causal credit

strongest_counterhypothesis: A separately persisted exactly-once consumption ledger may be unnecessary if all persistent learning is redesigned as an idempotent pure function of a canonical set of unique terminal receipts and a versioned deterministic fold/rebuild. That design could eliminate per-event consume mutations but must prove deterministic replay cost, ordering semantics, snapshot/recovery and incremental performance.

required_discriminator.name: REWARD_ACK_LOSS_AND_REPLAY_EXACTLY_ONCE
arms: process crash after plasticity commit before caller acknowledgement
restart and retry same terminal receipt
semantic state rollback with surviving consumption authority
required_discriminator.acceptance: one terminal outcome causes exactly one admitted persistent state transition under all tested retry/crash/restart paths; duplicate reads remain evidence-only

coordination_reason_for_no_immediate_sch: Current repository has many active UnifiedDB/V17/recovery lanes. Introducing a new persistent table without composing their identity, migration, rollback and selected-lineage contracts risks a second state architecture. This GO records the blocker and test obligation first.
architecture_delta: DO_NOT_CONNECT_TERMINAL_REWARD_BRIDGE_DIRECTLY_TO_MUTATING_PLASTICITY_UNTIL EXACTLY-ONCE CONSUMPTION OR DETERMINISTIC-IDEMPOTENT-FOLD SEMANTICS ARE TARGET-PROVEN
